race.comment: LANCETTA (10) is a well-bred mare who resumed with an encouraging run here when working home well for a narrow third. She was beaten under a length on that occasion and should strip fitter being so sparingly raced. Better now and rates highly. EGERTON REEF (1) is racing well without breaking through. He just found one better here two back before another good effort over the same route. He'll roll forward and give a sight. VIPERSTRIKE (8) is coming along okay for this having put in a better effort at Murtoa last start finishing fourth. He draws nicely and can figure. ETCHED IN BLUE (2) has placed his past three and won't need to do a whole lot more to be figuring prominently again. PRESTIGE ZERPRISE (5) next best.
